We had a dusting of snow yesterday into the early evening and then the fog rolled in, which left us with some very sticky snow. There was no freeze on the inner trails that I could feel, but conditions were looking very nice. Pretty Valley Road is looking good from Aitkens down. The Nordic Bowl has been smoothed out and fully groomed, along with Horseyard Loop, Panorama Loop and the Aqueduct from High Plains Road to the Dam wall. High Plains Road has recovered ever so slightly with the cold temperatures and the dusting of snow. However, it is still very patchy for the first few hundred meters from Windy Corner. Hoppet Start has been groomed one cat wide on the left (facing down hill) Track setting came out a lot nicer with the softer snow tonight.
